state.objective: Choose the clearest and safest Finance navigation for the existing frontend-hub, grounded in actual menus and the previously approved process-owner, poster, approval, and segregation-of-duties model.
state.legal_and_operating_context: One Indonesian PT Perorangan with HO and multiple retail units as sites of the same legal entity. Finance and bank access are centralized at HO. Units handle physical sales cash, cashier float, petty cash, deposits/handoffs, stock receipt/count, and operational evidence. Units cannot access company bank accounts, choose arbitrary GL accounts, transact unit-to-unit, or make unrestricted manual journals.
state.accounting_model: Approved source documents generate subledger postings. Restricted HO General Accounting handles exceptional manual journals. Process owner, poster, approver, payment releaser, and reconciler are separate responsibilities.
state.working_coa: 225 working natural accounts with site_id and governed operational dimensions. Forms capture business events instead of exposing the full chart.
important_product_facts: The central frontend-hub is primarily a head-office console; operational store workflows may originate in the store frontend and become read/review screens in the hub.
Supplier master and purchase orders belong to GA/Procurement; Finance validates invoices, manages AP, and executes controlled payments.
Physical asset identity/location belongs to GA; capitalization, depreciation, impairment, and disposal accounting belong to Finance.
Payroll employee data belongs to HR; payroll accounting and payment controls involve Finance/Treasury.
Inventory owns quantities and movements; Finance reads valuation and posts controlled accounting adjustments.
Commercial owns selling terms; Finance reconciles settlements and accounting consequences.
Bank master and bank operations are HO-only, with maker-checker and independent reconciliation.
Navigation may be role-filtered, but server authorization remains authoritative.

overall_shape.instructions: Which overall Finance navigation shape best fits this company and application?

criteria.active_plus_role_views: Keep the active compact Finance structure, improve labels and use role-filtered views/actions inside screens.
criteria.finance_final_split: Adopt the full Store, Accounting and Reports split from Finance final as one large Finance module.
criteria.hybrid: Use a compact HO Finance module while keeping operational Unit money tasks in Operations/Store and linking their evidence into Finance.

primary_grouping.instructions: What should be the primary grouping principle inside the central Finance menu?

criteria.job_stage: Daily work, books/reports, and controlled setup/close.
criteria.accounting_domain: Cash, AP, AR, assets, tax, GL and reports.

unit_tasks_location.instructions: Where should unit-facing cash count, sales reconciliation, petty cash evidence and deposit-handoff tasks primarily live?

criteria.operations_store: Operations or Store workspace, with Finance receiving evidence and exceptions.
criteria.finance_store_section: A Store section inside central Finance.
criteria.both_full: Duplicate the complete workflows in Operations and Finance.

finance_unit_visibility.instructions: What should unit users see in the central Finance module?

criteria.none_or_status: No central Finance navigation, or read-only status limited to their submitted operational documents.

criteria.role_queue: Role-specific work queue, exceptions, approvals, and close readiness.
criteria.menu_catalog: A catalog repeating every menu link.

supplier_bills_label.instructions: What is the clearest menu label for invoice validation, matching, AP aging and posting?

criteria.accounts_payable: Accounts payable, with Bills/Invoices as views or actions.

supplier_master_location.instructions: Where should supplier/vendor master creation live?

criteria.duplicate: Both modules maintain separate supplier masters.

payments_scope.instructions: What should the Finance Payments menu contain?

criteria.treasury_execution: Approved payment batches/instructions, approval and bank release status; invoice selection starts from AP.
criteria.all_money: Every cash, bank, petty-cash and settlement event.
criteria.bill_action_only: No Payments menu; every payment only exists as an action on a bill.

payment_instruction_location.instructions: Where should payment instructions prepared from approved obligations appear?

criteria.payments_view: A queue/view within Payments or Treasury, not a separate top-level menu.

cash_bank_split.instructions: How should HO cash and bank work be navigated?

criteria.one_workspace: One Cash & bank workspace with tabs/views for accounts, statements, transactions, reconciliation and cash counts.
criteria.six_items: Separate top-level items for Cash, Cash Counts, Banks, Bank Accounts, Bank Transactions and Bank Reconciliation.

bank_master_location.instructions: Where should Banks and Bank Accounts master/setup live?

criteria.cash_bank_settings: Inside Cash & bank as a restricted settings/register view.
criteria.master_global: Global Master Data module available to all departments.

bank_reconciliation_separation.instructions: Should bank reconciliation be distinct from payment reconciliation?

criteria.separate_views: Yes, distinct views/jobs, possibly within related workspaces.
criteria.one_reconcile: Combine them into one generic reconciliation screen.

unmatched_charge_location.instructions: Where should charges without a sale be located?

criteria.cash_bank_exception: An exception queue/view inside Cash & bank, surfaced on Overview.
criteria.top_level: Keep a dedicated Finance top-level menu.

asset_menu_split.instructions: How should asset menus be divided?

criteria.split_register_accounting: GA owns physical asset register; Finance has asset accounting view for capitalization, depreciation, impairment and disposal.
criteria.finance_all: Finance owns one complete Assets screen including custody.
criteria.ga_all: GA owns physical and accounting treatment.

journal_visibility.instructions: How should Journal appear in navigation?

criteria.restricted_top_level: Keep as a clearly restricted Finance item for authorized General Accounting users.
criteria.inside_ledger: Only an action inside Ledger, with no menu item.
criteria.all_users: Show manual journal creation to every department.

journal_label.instructions: Which label best prevents users from mistaking system postings for manual entry?

reports_granularity.instructions: How should financial reports appear in the sidebar?

criteria.one_reports: One Reports menu with P&L, balance sheet, cash flow and aging as report tabs/cards; Ledger remains separate.
criteria.each_report: Every report is a separate sidebar row.
criteria.ledger_only: All statements are folded into Ledger.

sales_register_location.instructions: Where should Sales Register primarily live?

criteria.sales_module: Sales/Commercial, with Finance cross-link or report access.
criteria.duplicate: Separate maintained copies in Sales and Finance.

coa_location.instructions: Where should the reduced Chart of Accounts be maintained?

criteria.finance_restricted: Restricted Finance Setup, because accounting owns natural-account governance.
criteria.master_global: Global Master Data for broad access.

line_categories_location.instructions: Where should Line Categories be managed?

criteria.account_map: Inside Account map/posting rules as governed posting dimensions or meanings.
criteria.coa_subview: A subview inside Chart of Accounts.

account_map_location.instructions: How should Account Map be exposed?

criteria.restricted_rules: Restricted Posting rules/setup screen, with unmapped exceptions visible on Overview.
criteria.top_level_all: A top-level menu visible to all Finance and unit users.

giro_print_location.instructions: Where should Giro printing configuration and actual printing live?

criteria.split: Restricted bank-account print layout in Cash & bank settings; actual print action on an approved payment.
criteria.payments: Both configuration and printing live indiscriminately inside Payments.

period_close_location.instructions: How should close controls be presented?

criteria.one_close: One Period close workspace combining checklist, controls, approvals and run actions.
criteria.two_menus: Separate Controls & close and Period close top-level menus.
criteria.reports: A report-only screen with no controlled actions.

tax_location.instructions: Should Tax be a permanent Finance sidebar item for this company?

criteria.role_item: Yes, but visible only to Tax/Finance roles and focused on obligations, filings and reconciliation.
criteria.inside_close: Keep tax position/checks inside Reports and Period close until workflow volume justifies a dedicated item.
criteria.all_users: Show it to all users including units.

prepaid_design.instructions: How should prepaids and accruals be navigated?

criteria.one_workspace: One Prepaids & accruals workspace with schedules as views/details.
criteria.two_items: Separate Prepaids & Accruals and Prepaid schedules sidebar rows.
criteria.journal_only: No subledger; use unrestricted manual journals.

advances_location.instructions: Where should employee/vendor advances be handled?

criteria.ap_ar_view: A view within AP/AR according to party/purpose, with aging and settlement.
criteria.top_level: A separate Finance top-level Advances item.
criteria.people_only: All advances live only in HR/People.

financing_owner_menu.instructions: How should bank loans and owner capital/drawings be presented?

criteria.restricted_financing: One restricted Financing workspace with separate loan and owner-equity views.
criteria.payments: Treat both as ordinary Payments rows only.
criteria.no_menu: Manage both exclusively through manual journals.

payroll_menu_location.instructions: Where should payroll navigation be split?

criteria.people_plus_finance: HR/People owns payroll run inputs/review; Finance exposes payroll payable, funding/payment and accounting reconciliation as linked views.
criteria.people_all: Finance has no payroll payable or reconciliation visibility.

inventory_accounting_location.instructions: Where should inventory accounting exceptions and valuation review live?

criteria.inventory_with_finance_review: Inventory owns operational workspace; Finance Overview/close links to valuation and controlled accounting exceptions.
criteria.finance_top: A full Inventory Accounting top-level Finance section.

role_filtering.instructions: How should menus differ among AP, Treasury, General Accounting, Finance Manager and Auditor?

criteria.role_filtered: Show each role its own work and read-only dependencies, while preserving server enforcement and search access where authorized.
criteria.same_menu: Show every Finance item to every role.
criteria.separate_apps: Build a separate application for every Finance role.

recommended_visible_count.instructions: How many persistent sidebar rows should the normal HO Finance user see, excluding nested tabs/views?
